title: Three Bound Blue Demons
description: Three blue-skinned demonic figures with horns stand together in a stone archway. The central muscular demon has glowing golden bandages across his chest while the others are wrapped in mummy-like wrappings, one with a bandaged face, all surrounded by swirling mist and torchlight.
prompt: Three menacing blue demons with curved horns and glowing white eyes stand in a dark stone archway carved with demonic faces. The muscular central demon has golden glowing bandages wrapped across his chest and arms, while the other two are tightly wrapped in aged mummy bandages, one completely covering his face except for one eye. Dramatic torchlight illuminates the scene from the sides, thick green mist swirls around their legs, dark fantasy atmosphere, cinematic lighting, detailed textures
